items.stem: Which principle should govern validation selection?

options.text: Choose the option with the highest setup effort.
Use the lightest option that credibly resolves the remaining buying uncertainty.
Always require a full pilot.
Always prohibit a pilot regardless of need.

items.stem: Which environment statement should an author verify before external publication?

options.text: Only the deck's cover color.
That all environments perfectly reproduce production.
Current data handling, identity, isolation, limits and allowed validation claims.
That every old price and ARR gate is permanent.

items.stem: What is essential before a sandbox workshop?

options.text: Authorized data/access, champion alignment, tested representative tasks and clear limits.
An unbounded invitation to every user.
Promising every production behavior will be identical.
Uploading all customer data without review.

items.stem: Which situation best justifies a pilot request?

options.text: A curious contact requests free access with no owner.
Prior work is complete and a scoped, important buying question cannot be resolved adequately by lighter validation.
The team has not yet identified any workflow.
A seller needs to inflate activity count.

items.stem: Readiness is 84%, but approvals and the signed required order form are absent. Can deployment begin?

options.text: No; readiness evidence does not replace required approvals and commercial prerequisites.
Yes; 80% automatically authorizes deployment.
Yes; a sponsor's excitement replaces all approvals.
Yes; a generated score overrides policy.

items.stem: What belongs in a validation stop rule?

options.text: Permission to expand data without review.
A promise that no result can ever be a no-go.
A specific unmet dependency or criterion, owner notification and a pause/narrow/defer decision.
Automatic indefinite extension.

items.stem: The SE cannot establish permission feasibility for a priority workflow by the checkpoint. What is best?

options.text: Claim permission inheritance is guaranteed without evidence.
Hide the dependency from the sponsor.
Start deployment and hope it works.
Pause or narrow that use case and reconfirm the validation plan with owners.
